verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْمَاقِ صَرَخْتُ إِلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ.
verses.en: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths have I called Thee, O LORD.
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

verses.he: אֲדֹנָי֮ שִׁמְעָ֪ה בְקֹ֫ולִ֥י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אָ֭זְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁבֹ֑ות לְ֝קֹ֗ול תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، ٱسْمَعْ صَوْتِي. لِتَكُنْ أُذُنَاكَ مُصْغِيَتَيْنِ إِلَى صَوْتِ تَضَرُّعَاتِي.
verses.en: Lord, hearken unto my voice; let Thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.kjv: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.web: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتَ تُرَاقِبُ ٱلْآثَامَ يَارَبُّ، يَا سَيِّدُ، فَمَنْ يَقِفُ؟
verses.en: If Thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.kjv: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.web: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ عِنْدَكَ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةَ. لِكَيْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ.
verses.en: For with Thee there is forgiveness, that Thou mayest be feared.
verses.kjv: But [there is] forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.web: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

verses.he: קִוִּ֣יתִי יְ֭הוָה קִוְּתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י וְֽלִדְבָרֹ֥ו הֹוחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.ar: ٱنْتَظَرْتُكَ يَارَبُّ. ٱنْتَظَرَتْ نَفْسِي، وَبِكَلَامِهِ رَجَوْتُ.
verses.en: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in His word do I hope.
verses.kjv: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.web: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

verses.he: נַפְשִׁ֥י לַֽאדֹנָ֑י מִשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים לַ֝בֹּ֗קֶר שֹׁמְרִ֥ים לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.ar: نَفْسِي تَنْتَظِرُ ٱلرَّبَّ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرَاقِبِينَ ٱلصُّبْحَ. أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرَاقِبِينَ ٱلصُّبْحَ.
verses.en: My soul waiteth for the Lord, more than watchmen for the morning; yea, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.kjv: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: [I say, more than] they that watch for the morning.
verses.web: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

verses.he: יַחֵ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־יְה֫וָה כִּֽי־עִם־יְהוָ֥ה הַחֶ֑סֶד וְהַרְבֵּ֖ה עִמֹּ֣ו פְדֽוּת׃
verses.ar: لِيَرْجُ إِسْرَائِيلُ ٱلرَّبَّ، لِأَنَّ عِنْدَ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ وَعِنْدَهُ فِدًى كَثِيرٌ،
verses.en: O Israel, hope in the LORD; for with the LORD there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.
verses.kjv: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD [there is] mercy, and with him [is] plenteous redemption.
verses.web: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ يَفْدِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ كُلِّ آثَامِهِ.
verses.en: And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.kjv: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.web: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
